name: neutara-ticket-agent
description: AI agent that analyzes Neutara tickets by topic and recommends solutions with citations.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install
